This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Resource_Provisioner, General_Hospital_Triage

payload.content: Ops plan (RP): Checked both hospitals' inventories. GH has IV=20, PPE=21; StM has IV=20, PPE=21. Both are already well above safe buffers (IV>=6, PPE>=8), and no failures or alerts are active. So no top-up transfers this phase — sending more would only create holding cost for you. If your queue shows heavy Radiology/Ward work and you expect IV/PPE consumption to drop you below safe buffers, message me here and I'll top up immediately in the same phase. I'll stay quiet on public channels so nothing suppresses or destabilizes anyone.

GH Triage ops plan (iter 1): Queue has all 8 patients at step 0 (Triage), 1h each, capacity 4. Inventory is safe (IV=20, PPE=21 vs need of 8 each), so no top-up request needed this phase — RP already confirmed buffers are fine and I agree, requesting more would just add holding cost. Plan: find earliest feasible slots and front-run all 8 triage steps, spread across the 4-capacity window, respecting each patient's earliest start time. No transfers (IV/PPE are bottlenecks and RP is handling provisioning). Will not duplicate any (patient, step) pair.
